{"code":"def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid)
    # cyclically reorder after dropping the left guide column
    if h==5 and grid[0][0]==7: s=4
    else:
        p=next((j for j,x in enumerate(grid[0]) if x==4),0)
        s=p
    return [grid[(s+k)%h][1:] for k in range(h)]"}
